name: axiom-tensor-compiler-engineering
description: Building compilers for tensor programs - lowering a canonical graph IR to executable PyTorch (torch.fx / torch.compile / AOTAutograd), operator lowering and kernel selection, fusion and memory planning, compilation manifests, artifact identity and caching - and above all conformance: proving the compiled artefact preserves canonical semantics through reference execution, gradient conformance, and cross-device/cross-layout agreement, judged by a gate independent of the compiler. Producer-side sibling of axiom-static-analysis-engineering: that pack reads code and produces verdicts; this one transforms IR and produces executables.
